title: 第二十三章 合伙打渔第二十四章 银鲳鱼群
content_zh:
村里这闲言碎语传得可真够快的，殷东大汗，忙说：“昨天我去客运站，是秋总送我去的，刚才就请她到家里喝个茶。”
“哦，昨天就联系上的，动作够迅速的啊。”
王海娇酸酸的说。
殷东头皮有些发麻，哄女人需要天赋，他是真没有，赶紧转移话题：“娇姐，你再帮我照顾一下小宝，我回家洗个澡啊。”
“早给你烧好热水了，饭菜也早做好了，小宝睡了，我把他放床上就走了。”
王海娇语气生硬，语速飞快，炒豆子似的说完，快步抱着小宝打头里走了。
殷东大汗，正要追上去再解释两句，可是手机响了，是顾文打来的。
他以为是说龙虾的事情，却不想顾文语气紧张的说：“东子，怎么办？我跟铁山叔说的事，我爸全知道了，现在我爸从京城赶回来了，要我在家等他。”
“……”
殷东无言，是啊，他只想着前世哑巴铁山对顾文忠心，拼死保护，却忘了铁山首先是忠于顾文爸的。
“要是我说，是我同学在医院公厕里听的小道消息，我爸肯定不信啊！”
顾文在电话那头压低了嗓音说，没说他其实也不信，真要是吴冬林的秘密，会让手下会在医院公厕里说出来，也不可能成为他爸的左膀右臂了。
只不过，顾文不想追问殷东得到消息的渠道。
“那你就说是一个游方道士说的吧，他是我师父，左眉毛上有一个黑痣，是我那年去五夷山旅游时拜的师父，我师父道观的位置，我一会发给你，你让他去找我师父问吧。”
“东子，你说的是真还是假？”
“我真有一个老道士师父。”
殷东说，没说是前世拜的师父。
反正这么大事儿，把闲云野鹤般的老道士推出来当挡箭牌，不怕顾文爸去查。
顾文竟然答应了：“好吧，那我就这么说。”
听出顾文的紧张，殷东不由失笑道：“那是你亲爸，你紧张什么啊？要不，等你爸回来，你让他也来大湾村考察吧，我来跟他说这事儿。

正好我们这儿有个投资商过来考察，你让他过来，给我们村造造势吧。”
“这主意不错，我还真怕一个人跟我爸说这个事，忒怕露马脚。”
顾文说，完全没注意自己的语病。
殷东挂了电话，摇头失笑。
他还是把顾文当成了在前世在追杀之中的时候，那么处变不惊跟心狠手辣，却忘了现在的顾文还是温室里的花朵。
就是打电话的功夫，王海娇把小宝安置好了，己经离开，殷东就远远看到她的背影，不由得苦笑。
出海归来，就能洗热水澡，再有一顿热饭热菜吃，那感觉真不是一般的好，殷东反正是感动了，脑子里不由自主闪过王海娇的身影，尤其是饱满到快要撑破制服的大胸，让他一阵兽血沸腾，又不禁反抽了自己一巴掌，低声咒骂了一声：“禽，兽！”
就在这时，外面响起一声：“东子在家吗？”
“在啊！”
殷东应了一声，出去一看，是才哥夫妻俩来了，手里还拎着大包小包的东西，忙说：“才哥，嫂子，你们俩怎么有空过来了。”
“我们来蹭饭的。”
才哥开了个玩笑，伸手抱过小宝，把手上拎的东西交给了殷东，“你别跟哥推啊，这是我这个做伯伯的买给小宝的。”
话说到这份上，殷东真不好推让了，只得把东西接了，请他们夫妻俩进屋坐了。
content_en:
The gossip spread really fast in the village. Yin Dong sweated profusely and said hurriedly: "Yesterday I went to the passenger terminal. Mr. Qiu sent me there. I just invited her to my house for tea."
"Oh, I contacted him yesterday. He acted very quickly."
Wang Haijiao said sourly.
Yin Dong's scalp was a little numb. It takes talent to coax women, but he really didn't have it. He quickly changed the subject: "Sister Jiao, please help me take care of Xiaobao. I'll go home and take a bath."
"I have boiled hot water for you a long time ago, and the food has been prepared. The little baby has gone to bed, so I put him on the bed and left."
Wang Haijiao's tone was stiff and she spoke very quickly. After she finished speaking, she quickly hugged Xiaobao and walked away.
Yin Dong sweated profusely and was about to catch up and explain a few more words, but his cell phone rang and it was Gu Wen calling.
He thought he was talking about the lobster, but Gu Wen said nervously: "Dongzi, what should I do? My dad knows everything about what I told Uncle Tieshan. Now my dad has rushed back from the capital and wants me to wait for him at home."
"..."
Yin Dong was speechless, yes, he only thought about the mute Tieshan who was loyal to Gu Wen in his previous life and protected him to the death, but he forgot that Tieshan was first loyal to Gu Wen's father.
"If I said it was gossip my classmates heard in the public toilets of the hospital, my dad would definitely not believe it!"
Gu Wen lowered his voice on the other end of the phone and said that even though he didn't say it, he actually didn't believe it. If Wu Donglin's secret was revealed by his subordinates in the hospital's public toilet, he wouldn't be his father's right-hand man.
However, Gu Wen didn't want to ask how Yin Dong got the news.
"Then you can say that it was said by a wandering Taoist priest. He is my master. He has a black mole on his left eyebrow. He is the master I worshiped when I traveled to Wuyi Mountain that year. I will send you the location of my master's Taoist temple in a moment. You can ask him to ask my master."
"Dongzi, are what you said true or false?"
"I really have an old Taoist master."
Yin Dong said that he did not say that he was the master he worshiped in his previous life.
Anyway, it was such a big deal, and the old Taoist priest who looked like a wandering wild crane was pushed out as a shield, so he was not afraid of Gu Wen's father going to investigate.
Gu Wen actually agreed: "Okay, that's what I'll say."
Hearing Gu Wen's nervousness, Yin Dong couldn't help but laugh and said: "That's your biological father, why are you nervous? Otherwise, when your father comes back, you can ask him to come to Dawan Village to inspect, and I will tell him about it."
It just so happens that we have an investor here who comes over for inspection. Please ask him to come over and build momentum for our village. "
"That's a good idea. I'm really afraid of telling my father this alone, because I'm afraid of being exposed."
Gu Wen said, not paying attention to his speech problem at all.
Yin Dong hung up the phone, shook his head and laughed.
He still regarded Gu Wen as he was when he was being hunted in his previous life, so calm and ruthless, but he forgot that the current Gu Wen was still a flower in the greenhouse.
While they were on the phone, Wang Haijiao had placed Xiaobao and left. Yin Dong saw her back from a distance and couldn't help but smile bitterly.
After returning from the sea, he could take a hot bath and have a hot meal. It felt really good. Yin Dong was moved anyway, and the image of Wang Haijiao flashed through his mind involuntarily, especially the big breasts that were so full that they almost burst through his uniform. It made his blood boil, and he couldn't help but slap himself in the face, and cursed in a low voice: "Beast!"
At this moment, a voice sounded outside: "Is Dongzi at home?"
"Yes!"
Yin Dong responded, and when he went out to see, it was Brother Cai and his wife who were here, carrying large and small bags of things in their hands. He hurriedly said, "Brother Cai, sister-in-law, why are you two here when you have time?"
"We're here to eat."
Brother Cai made a joke, reached out and hugged Xiaobao, and handed the things in his hand to Yin Dong, "Don't push it with me, I, the uncle, bought this for Xiaobao."
Speaking of this, Yin Dong really couldn't give in, so he had to take the things and invite the couple into the room to sit.
